title: sebastiania subsessilis
intro: Sebastiania subsessilis, commonly known as "Cipo", is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help alleviate various conditions such as pain, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Sebastiania subsessilis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit potential as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agents. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Sebastiania subsessilis, but its traditional use in folk medicine has been documented in various regions.
